text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Kawalan Harga dan Antipencatutan (Perniagaan yang Ditetapkan) 2017.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2018.

Perniagaan yang ditetapkan

2. Bagi maksud seksyen 10 B Akta, p erniagaan yang ditetapkan hendaklah
sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL
[Peraturan  2]

PERNIAGAAN YANG DITETAPKAN

1. Perniagaan hotel , iaitu suatu perniagaan hotel, rumah inapan , rumah
tumpangan, rumah rehat  atau rumah pemalaman  yang menawarkan
penginapan atau tempat tidur untuk disewa atau apa -apa bentuk ganjaran
yang lain tanpa mengira sama ada makanan atau minuman juga di tawarkan
untuk jualan.

Perniagaan makanan atau minuman , iaitu suatu perniagaan yang
menawarkan untuk jualan apa -apa makanan atau minuman yang disediakan
untuk atau dihidangkan kepada pelanggan, termasuk suatu perniagaan
penghantaran makanan atau minuman kepada pelanggan.

Dibuat 13 Disember 2017
[KPDNKK600-1/2/38; PN(PU2)695/XIX]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN
Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,
Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING ACT 2011

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING
(PRESCRIBED BUSINESS) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 10 B and 60 of the
Price Control and Anti-Profiteering Act 2011 [Act 723], the Minister makes the following
regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Price Control and Anti -Profiteering
(Prescribed Business) Regulations 2017.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2018.

Prescribed business
2. For the purposes of section 10 B of the Act, t he prescribed business shall be  as
specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE
[Regulation 2]

PRESCRIBED BUSINESS

1. Hotel business, that is a business of hotels, inns, boarding-houses, rest houses
or lodging houses which offers lodging or sleeping accommodation for hire or
any other form of reward regardless of whether food or drink is also offered
for sale.

2. Food or beverages business, that is a business which offers for sale any food
or beverages prepared for or served to customer s, including a business of
delivering food or beverages to customers.

Made  13 December 2017
[KPDNKK600-1/2/38; PN(PU2)695/XIX]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN
           Minister of Domestic Trade,
         Co-operatives and Consumerism
